name: cnmf
title: cNMF run outputs (per-dataset bundle)
description: Outputs of the torch-cNMF gene program inference pipeline (`external/cNMF_benchmarking/cNMF_benchmarking_pipeline/Inference/torch-cNMF/`). For each production dataset, the pipeline runs cNMF across a sweep of k values and density thresholds, the group selects a k for downstream analysis, and the bundle mirrored to Synapse contains both (1) the full output at the selected k and (2) enough sweep artifacts to revisit the k decision without re-running cNMF. Used by Working Group 1 (gene programs as primary building blocks; TOPICS.md Topic 1) and Working Group 2 (cross-lineage program loading similarity, regulators per program, lineage-specific enrichment; TOPICS.md Topic 2 / WG2 in WORKING_GROUPS.md).
_verification_status: VERIFIED against the Hon WTC11 benchmark reference run `030726_20iter_5KHVG_torch_halsvar_batch_e7` (72 GB total) under `datasets/Hon_WTC11-benchmark_TF-Perturb-seq/PerturbNMF/Result/`. File names + per-(k,dt) sweep structure are confirmed for `gene_spectra_score`, `gene_spectra_tpm`, `spectra.consensus`, `starcat_spectra`, `usages.consensus`, `clustering.k_<X>.dt_<Y>.png`, `k_selection.png`, `k_selection_stats.df.npz`, `overdispersed_genes.txt`, and the 12-13 evaluation TXT files inside each `Eval/<k>_<dt>/` subdir. SAMPLED (column-level not yet enumerated) for `Annotation/<k>_<dt>.xlsx`, `Interpretation/Summary_table/<k>_<dt>/`, the integrated MuData (`adata/cNMF_<k>_<dt>.h5mu`) internal structure, and the `Plot/{Program_*,Perturb_gene_*,k_selection_*}/` PDF inventories. No production-dataset run has been mirrored to Synapse yet — first end-to-end verification will happen against the first production cNMF run that lands.
bundle_path_synapse: 2026_UTSW/datasets/<dataset_id>/cnmf/  (or .../cnmf/<run_name>/ for multi-run datasets — pass --use-run-name to the mirror tool to enable)

submodules.external/cNMF_benchmarking: Pipeline repo with Slurm + Jupyter variants for inference, evaluation, k-selection, and plotting/Excel summarization.

runner.input: AnnData built from the inference MuData by `Convert_file_adata.py` (gene mod becomes .X with raw counts; guide assignment, names, targets, X_PCA, X_umap moved into uns/obsm). Documented in docs/analysis/cNMF.md.

sweep.note: Across all datasets we run with multiple density thresholds but `sel_thresh = 2.0` is the canonical downstream threshold (per docs/analysis/cNMF.md). The k-value sweep is the same across the production datasets (production list above).

runner.k_selection_process: Group decision (clinical-review-board style). Top 10-15 k values are picked from the stability-error plot, then the cNMF_k_selection notebook produces enrichment / perturbation-recovery / explained-variance summary plots. Final k is chosen by group consensus and recorded in the per-run README.txt and in this file's `production_runs_status` block.

files.name: <run_name>.gene_spectra_score.k_<k>.dt_<dt>.txt
files.description: Z-scored gene loadings: rows = programs (1..k), columns = genes (Ensembl IDs). Primary input for cross-lineage program-similarity comparisons (WG2). Mirrored at the selected k AND at every k in the sweep (one density threshold) so a reader can spot-check what programs would look like at an alternate k without re-running cNMF.
files.approx_size_per_file_mb: 1 to 38 (scales with k; k=200 is ~38 MB)

files.name: <run_name>.gene_spectra_tpm.k_<sel>.dt_2_0.txt
files.description: TPM-normalized gene loadings. Same shape as `gene_spectra_score`; useful when ranking genes within a program by absolute (rather than normalized) contribution.
files.approx_size_per_file_mb: 0.6 to 11 at the selected k (depends on k)

files.name: <run_name>.spectra.k_<sel>.dt_2_0.consensus.txt
files.description: Consensus W matrix (programs × genes) — direct cNMF output before z-scoring or TPM normalization. Mirrored at the selected k for downstream that wants the raw consensus.

files.name: <run_name>.starcat_spectra.k_<sel>.dt_2_0.txt
files.description: STARCAT-normalized spectra (programs × genes) — alternative normalization of the consensus W.

files.name: <run_name>.usages.k_<sel>.dt_2_0.consensus.txt
files.description: Cell × program usages (H matrix). Rows = cells, columns = programs (1..k). The cell-level program activations used by WG1 (which programs are affected per perturbation) and WG2 (program activations across cell states). NOT mirrored across the k sweep — too bulky (157 MB at k=200) and the selected-k version is the only one needed for downstream analyses.

files.name: <run_name>.clustering.k_<X>.dt_<Y>.png
files.description: Per-(k,dt) clustergram + local-density histogram (cNMF's built-in QC plot — shows program separation and consensus stability). Mirrored across the full sweep so a reader can visually inspect program separation at alternate k.

files.name: <run_name>.k_selection.png
files.description: Stability-vs-error curve across the k sweep — the canonical visual used by the group to pick a k.

files.name: <run_name>.k_selection_stats.df.npz
files.description: Raw stats array behind `k_selection.png` (one row per k value). Lets a reader re-plot or apply alternate k-selection criteria.

files.name: <run_name>.overdispersed_genes.txt
files.description: List of HVGs (top-N by overdispersion) cNMF was run on. Required to interpret loadings and to re-run with the same gene set.

files.name: Eval/<k>_<dt>/
files.description: Per-(k,dt) evaluation output bundle (12-13 TXT files). Mirrored across the full sweep — these files are how the group evaluates which k to pick (they drive the `cNMF_k_selection` plots) and they're small (~50 MB total across all k). Keeping the full sweep here is what makes the k decision auditable.

files_per_subdir.name: <k>_Explained_Variance_Summary.txt
files_per_subdir.description: Cumulative explained variance summary at this k.

files_per_subdir.name: <k>_categorical_association_posthoc.txt
files_per_subdir.description: Post-hoc pairwise tests for the categorical associations above.

files_per_subdir.name: <k>_geneset_enrichment.txt
files_per_subdir.description: MSigDB / curated gene-set enrichment per program.

files_per_subdir.name: <k>_perturbation_association_results_<batch>.txt
files_per_subdir.description: Per-program perturbation association test results — one file per batch (e.g., `IGVFDS6244NAXC`, `IGVFDS8721BKRO`, ..., plus an aggregated `WTC` file in the Hon benchmark). Working Group 2 uses these to identify regulators of each program.

files_per_subdir.name: <k>_fake_perturbation_association_calibration.txt
files_per_subdir.description: Optional. Negative-control perturbation calibration. Present at a subset of k values in the Hon benchmark (k = 10, 35, 40, 50, 80, 90).

files.name: adata/cNMF_<sel>_2_0.h5mu
files.description: Integrated MuData at the selected k. Single canonical handoff for downstream: gene mod (cells × genes) + guide mod (cells × guides) + cNMF mod (cells × programs with `varm['loadings']` = programs × genes). The cNMF.md handbook documents the post-inference structure: `cNMF.X` = cell × program loadings, `cNMF.varm['loadings']` = program × gene loadings, `obsm`/`uns` mirrored from the gene mod for plotting (X_PCA, X_umap, guide_assignment, guide_names, guide_targets). NOT mirrored across the k sweep — this one file is the dominant chunk (~1.7 GB) so we only keep the selected-k version.

files.name: Annotation/<sel>_2_0.xlsx
files.description: Per-(k,dt) annotated workbook integrating program loadings + top genes + enrichment summaries. Built by the Plotting / Excel-summarization step. Sampled-only (column-level inventory not yet documented).

files.name: Interpretation/Summary_table/<sel>_2_0/
files.description: Compiled summary tables (TSV/XLSX/TXT) integrating mdata + evaluation results at the selected k. Sampled-only; specific filenames not yet documented.

files.name: Plot/Program_<sel>_<dt>/
files.description: Program-QC PDFs at the selected k (program UMAP, program violin, loading correlations, top GO term plot, top loading genes, regulated-program volcano + dot + waterfall + bar plots). Folder is named by selected k, e.g., `Program_50_2_0/` in the Hon benchmark.

files.name: Plot/Perturb_gene_<sel>_<dt>/
files.description: Perturbed-gene PDFs at the selected k (gene UMAP, guide UMAP, gene dotplot, gene loading correlations, top loading programs, regulated-program volcano + dot + waterfall + bar plots).

files.name: Plot/k_selection_<run_id>/
files.description: k-selection figure folder produced by `cNMF_k_selection.ipynb`: stability-error, GO/genesets/trait enrichment by k, perturbation sensitivity by k, explained variance by k, program dot plot by conditions. Mirrored as part of the sweep-as-provenance layer so the k decision is auditable.

files.name: config_*.yml
files.description: SLURM job configs captured at run time (one per submission). Reproducibility.

files.name: logs/
files.description: SLURM `JOB_ID.err` / `JOB_ID.out` / `resource_monitor_JOB_ID.log` for each submission. Useful for wall-time / GPU-utilization auditing.

files.name: README.txt
files.description: Per-run notes (per cNMF.md): (1) the density threshold used, (2) the k value selected for downstream and the reasoning, (3) any other run notes (failures, re-runs, parameter overrides). This is the human-readable record of why this k was picked — what lets a future reader decide if the pick still holds without re-running anything.

purpose: (1) Selected-k full data for downstream analysis (WG1 + WG2): the integrated MuData, all loading variants, cell usages, full Eval/, and the selected-k Plot + Annotation + Interpretation folders.

(2) Sweep-as-provenance: enough sweep artifacts that the k decision is auditable and revisitable without re-running cNMF — k_selection.png + stats, all-k clustering pngs, all-k gene_spectra_score loadings, all-k Eval TXT bundles, k_selection_<run_id>/ figure folder, README.txt with selection rationale.

selected_k_only: Eval/<sel>_2_0/ (selected-k subdir is part of the full-Eval-sweep mirror, called out here for clarity)
all_k_sweep: <run_name>.gene_spectra_score.k_<X>.dt_2_0.txt for every k in the sweep
<run_name>.clustering.k_<X>.dt_<Y>.png for every k × both density thresholds
Eval/<X>_<Y>/ for every k × both density thresholds (full TXT bundle per (k,dt))

exclude: cnmf_tmp/ — NPZ cache files, regeneratable from the spectra/usages outputs
prog_data/NMF_<k>_<dt>.h5ad — duplicates info already in adata/cNMF_<k>_<dt>.h5mu
loading/cNMF_loadings_<k>_<dt>.txt — duplicate of the gene_spectra_* files

<run_name>.gene_spectra_tpm/spectra.consensus/starcat_spectra/usages.consensus for k != selected — same loadings as gene_spectra_score (other normalizations) or too bulky (usages); reader can re-derive if revisiting the k decision
adata/cNMF_<k>_<dt>.h5mu for k != selected — the dominant 70 GB of the run; selected-k MuData is sufficient
Evaluation/ legacy folder (mostly empty in the Hon benchmark)
bundle_inclusion_rule.estimated_bundle_size_gb: 5-7 per dataset (selected-k MuData ~1.7 GB + per-k gene_spectra_score sweep ~600 MB + Eval TXT sweep ~100 MB + selected-k tabular outputs + clustering pngs + plot folders + run-level files).
